nodes.text: A commission, since you're now a colleague. A locket, gold over brass, sentimental weight considerable, was *orphaned* some years ago when a courier misjudged the first climb. It remains with the, ah, current residents of the watchtower there.
The tower's old garrison. Previously alive. They observe traditional hours: sunset onward. By day you'll find swept stone and a view. _Go at night, and go armed._
The shielded ones keep the good things. The watch always did. Bring the locket whole and unopened. Provenance is my trade.
Pity. It was a *very* reasonable commission, considering the residents.
